name: Art illustration Chizhikov (Чижиков) Krea 2
description: ✨ About the Model This LoRA captures the unique, warm, and incredibly nostalgic style of vintage children's book illustrations by the legendary Soviet artist Viktor Chizhikov. It is perfect for generating images in the style of classic Soviet fairy tales, storybook characters, vintage greeting cards, and cozy, heartwarming illustrations. I would appreciate a like and any gratitude from you. 🤗🧡 The style is characterized by soft watercolor and gouache textures, expressive ink linework, warm pastel tones, and that special "cozy" atmosphere familiar to many from childhood. 🎨 About the Artist : Viktor Chizhikov (1935–2020) Viktor Chizhikov was an outstanding Soviet and Russian illustrator and People's Artist of the Russian Federation. His name is forever etched in the history of Eastern European visual culture. He created the visual look for many beloved childhood characters. Some of his most famous works include: Illustrations for Alexander Volkov's The Wizard of the Emerald City. Book editions of The Golden Key, or the Adventures of Buratino (A. Tolstoy) and The Jungle Book (R. Kipling). Illustrations for The Three Fat Men (Y. Olesha). Fun Fact: Viktor Chizhikov designed the famous Olympic Bear Misha, the mascot of the 1980 Moscow Summer Olympics! 👇👇 Prompting Tips: For the best results, add keywords describing the medium and vibe to your positive prompt: vintage children book illustration, watercolor, ink, gouache, warm colors, paper texture, expressive. " ilchizhikov, This is a colorful, whimsical illustration in a digital painting style " Auler/Simple A trigger word is not required! I would appreciate your rating and feedback!🧡
